Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.subsea

Class SURFCostEstimator.LineDesign

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.subsea.SURFCostEstimator.LineDesign
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
SURFCostEstimator
public static final class SURFCostEstimator.LineDesign extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable mechanical and installation basis for one physical line segment.

The basis is deliberately independent of hydraulic-model selection. It supplements a canonical route with the outer diameter, wall, material and installation inputs needed for Class 4 costing. A zero wall thickness requests the existing PipeMechanicalDesignCalculator screening calculation; it does not represent a qualified DNV-ST-F101 design.

    • resolveOverallHeatTransferCoefficientWm2K

      public double resolveOverallHeatTransferCoefficientWm2K()
      Resolve the steady overall heat-transfer coefficient on the pipe-bore area basis.

      An explicit value is authoritative. Otherwise, rigid-pipe wall and typed insulation data are routed through the existing multilayer thermal calculator. Flexible constructions require an explicit qualified U-value because a steel-wall radial model does not represent their layer stack.

      Returns:
      overall heat-transfer coefficient in W/(m2 K)
